paper_type_evidence.quote: In addition, we searched for emission lines produced by these species in a molecular line survey of Sagittarius B2(N) carried out with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA).

question.value: Measure the rotational spectra of 13C isotopologs of acetone in the laboratory and search for them, and for torsionally excited main-species acetone, in the EMoCA ALMA survey of Sgr B2(N2).

evidence.quote: We want to study the rotational spectra of CH$_3^{13}$C(O)CH$_3$ and $^{13}$CH$_3$C(O)CH$_3$ and search for them in Sagittarius B2(N2).
